name: Opacity-Thin-Side (OTS)
definition: A parameterization scheme for EWA-based splatting that ensures robust gradient-descent optimization by dynamically scaling the learned weight θ such that the projected amplitude a' equals θ when viewing the Gaussian along its thinnest side (shortest axis).
summary: Opacity-Thin-Side is a parameterization scheme for EWA-based splatting that ensures robust gradient-descent optimization by dynamically scaling learned weights to preserve view-independent mass while stabilizing thin objects.
